title: Failed OpenAI transcription items leave partial transcripts retained
reasoning: Delta events append text into _partial_transcripts by item_id, and completed events explicitly pop that item. The failed-event branch emits an error but does not remove the failed item_id from _partial_transcripts, so repeated failed transcription items after partial deltas can retain transcript text for the lifetime of the websocket session.
reproduction: Drive stream_events with a delta event for item_id X followed by conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.failed for the same item_id, then inspect that _partial_transcripts still contains X.
recommendation: In the failed-event branch, read item_id and pop it from _partial_transcripts before or after sending the error event, matching the completed branch cleanup behavior.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were included for OpenAI realtime event handling, and the excerpt shows no regression test asserting partial transcript cleanup on failed events.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a unit test for stream_events using a fake websocket that emits a delta followed by a failed event for the same item_id, then assert the session emits an error and no partial transcript entry remains.
minimumFixScope: backend/src/api/services/transcription/openai_realtime.py failed-event handling plus a focused backend unit test.
